description: This file defines the class 'UndeployedSubpanelImplementation', which extends 'AbstractMetaDataImplementation' and implements 'MetaDataImplementationInterface'. It manages the loading, modification, and saving of subpanel layout definitions for undeployed modules within SuiteCRM, including handling version history and integrating with the module's definitions.

classes.name: UndeployedSubpanelImplementation
classes.description: Manages subpanel layout definitions for undeployed modules, including loading/deploying definitions, managing version history, and integrating with module builder configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subpanel implementation by loading related module definitions, templates, and language strings; prepares internal state for editing the subpanel layout.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating that translation falls back to global mod_strings.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves the modified layout definitions for the subpanel, records the change in history, and updates the module's subpanel configuration.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Placeholder for method to return the filename related to a specific view, module, and package.
